en_title: ‘If Hits Are Unexpected, Datasets Aren’t Gonna Get You There’ — Take-Two Interactive and Sony Bosses Say That AI Cannot Replace Human Creativity
cn_title: 索尼等高管：AI无法取代人类创造力
subtitle: 爆款无法靠数据预测
opus_summary: Take-Two与索尼负责人认为，AI无法取代娱乐行业的人类创造力，但仍是有价值的工具。他们指出，数据集回顾过去，创造力着眼未来，出人意料的爆款并非靠数据就能打造。

paragraphs.en: Strauss Zelnick and Hiroki Totoki, the heads of Take-Two Interactive and Sony Group Corporation, agreed that AI won’t replace humans in the entertainment business during a talk at the Paley International Summit in New York City on Tuesday morning. They did, however, explain that they do see the technology as a valuable tool.
paragraphs.cn: 周二上午，Take-Two Interactive负责人Strauss Zelnick与索尼集团负责人十时裕树在纽约市举行的佩利国际峰会上对谈。两人一致认为，AI不会取代娱乐行业中的人类。不过，他们也表示，AI确实是有价值的工具。

paragraphs.en: “I don’t think an AI could replace humans because, particularly in the entertainment field, I think creativity is quite important. Creativity is for humans, not AI,” Totoki said. “How to use the technology profile is important. Of course, I encourage my people to use AI in a certain manner, but at [the] same time we try to keep the rights and rights holders and creators and artists.”
paragraphs.cn: 十时裕树表示：「我不认为AI能取代人类，因为我觉得创造力非常重要，尤其是在娱乐领域。创造力属于人类，而非AI。关键在于如何运用这项技术。当然，我鼓励员工以一定的方式使用AI，但与此同时，我们也努力保护相关权利，以及权利持有人、创作者和艺术家。」

paragraphs.en: “One of our division heads has said to his team, ‘You’re not gonna be replaced by AI, but if you’re not careful you’ll be replaced by someone who knows how to use AI,’” Zelnick said. “I’m fond of saying AI is a collection of datasets, compute, and large language models. That’s what it is. And datasets, by definition, are backward looking. That’s all they are. And creativity, at its best, is forward looking. [...]"
paragraphs.cn: Zelnick说：「我们有位部门负责人曾对团队说：「你们不会被AI取代，但如果不小心，就会被懂得使用AI的人取代。」我常说，AI就是数据集、算力和大语言模型的集合。它就是这么回事。而数据集从定义上来说，回顾的都是过去，仅此而已。创造力在最出色的时候，却是着眼未来的。［……］」

paragraphs.en: “When the first Grand Theft Auto was created, we thought the phrase ‘Grand Theft Auto’ wouldn't turn into what it’s turned into today,” Zelnick continued, then launching into an anecdote of his stint as president and chief operating officer of 20th Century Fox (now called 20th Century Studios).
paragraphs.cn: Zelnick接着说：「制作第一部《侠盗猎车手》时，我们以为「侠盗猎车手」这个名字不会发展成今天这样。」随后，他讲起了自己担任二十世纪福斯（现名二十世纪影业）总裁兼首席运营官时的一段经历。

paragraphs.en: “One of the biggest movies I was responsible for, Home Alone — it was completely unexpected. It went into production at Warner Bros. and they put it into turnaround four days into production, which [...] never happens. [...] Everyone thought it was a disaster. And It turned out to be the highest grossing comedy of all time. So if hits are unexpected, data sets aren’t gonna get you there, no matter how fluent they are.”
paragraphs.cn: 「《小鬼当家》是我负责过的最成功的电影之一，它的成功完全出人意料。这部电影最初由华纳兄弟投拍，开拍才四天，华纳就决定放弃，让项目另寻买家，这种事［……］根本不会发生。［……］所有人都觉得这部片子是场灾难，结果它却成了有史以来票房最高的喜剧片。所以，如果爆款总是出人意料，那么数据集无论表达得多么流畅，也没法帮你打造爆款。」

paragraphs.en: AI use in the production pipeline for games, movies, and TV is a hot-button issue. Just this week, a business strategist at Xbox posted (and then deleted) the "truth that nobody wants you to know" about how "gaming is the only industry pretending not to use AI," and Steam users implored the company to ban AI slop from the next Steam Next Fest. Last week, Epic Games revealed that its new store launcher was vibe coded . But Biddy Blas? AI could never.
paragraphs.cn: 在游戏、电影和电视的制作流程中使用AI，一直是个备受争议的话题。就在本周，XBOX一名商业策略师发文，揭露「没人想让你知道的真相」，声称「游戏业是唯一还在假装不用AI的行业」，随后又删除了帖子。Steam用户则恳请平台禁止AI垃圾内容参加下一届Steam新品节。上周，Epic Games透露，其新版商城启动器采用了氛围编程的开发方式。不过，换成《Biddy Blas》？AI可做不出来。
